## Description

A clear and concise summary of what this pull request accomplishes and why it is needed.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update (README, guides, ADRs)
- [ ] 🧹 Refactoring or maintenance (no behavior change)
- [ ] 🔒 Security or permission enhancement

---

## Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] I have executed the automated test suite (`npm test`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified that **zero secrets, credentials, or private API keys** are added.
- [ ] Security and permission implications (CapabilityBroker, ConfirmationDialog) were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and user guides have been updated if applicable.
- [ ] Release binaries and installer artifacts (`dist-release/`) were **NOT modified**.
- [ ] Frozen release tags (`v0.1.0`, `v0.1.1`) remain untouched.
- [ ] Any breaking changes or limitations are clearly documented above.
